description: This file manages tips and popups within the Notesnook mobile app, including tip state management, tip selection based on context, and user interface interactions.

classes.name: TipManager
classes.description: Handles initialization, retrieval, and marking of tips and popups, including state persistence.

methods.name: TipManager.init
methods.description: Initializes tip and popup states from persistent storage.

methods.name: TipManager.tip
methods.description: Retrieves a tip relevant to a specific context, respecting one-time display rules.

methods.name: TipManager.popup
methods.description: Fetches a popup by its ID.

methods.name: TipManager.markPopupUsed
methods.description: Marks a popup as used and updates persistent storage.

methods.name: useTip
methods.description: Custom React hook to manage and rotate tips based on context and options.
